Project brief

In a world where architecture breathes and infrastructure grows, Urban Mycelium envisions a city interwoven with living light. Each organism—part fungus, part technology—forms a network of bioluminescent structures that clean the air, guide the night, and nurture public life. From the floating Aerolume that purifies the atmosphere, to the grounding Glowstool that invites rest, these luminous hybrids reimagine urban ecology as a living, evolving organism.
